places.name: Court Square Diner
places.avoid: Skip fried items, bacon, tomato soup and coffee; ask for hot water or chamomile tea.
places.notes: Phone (718) 392-1222. Open since 1946; official ordering page states Open 24 hours and 24-hour delivery. The only reliable hot-food option after midnight near Court Square.

places.name: Dim Sum Palace (LIC)
places.address: 24-28 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
buy: Plain or chicken congee (白粥 / 鸡肉粥)
Steamed shrimp dumplings or rice rolls (虾饺 / 肠粉)
places.avoid: No fried items (fried crullers, garlic spare ribs); no chili sauce or youtiao in the congee.
places.notes: Opened June 26, 2025 in the former Brooks 1890 bar. All-day dim sum and congee; Queens Post (July 2025) says it closes at 2 a.m. nightly like the chain's other branches (some directories say 2:30 a.m.). Opening time not confirmed; 11:00 assumed from chain norm. Also listed as 2428 Jackson Ave.

places.name: Dun Huang (LIC)
places.address: 27-35 Jackson Ave, Space B, Long Island City, NY 11101
buy: Lanzhou clear-broth beef noodle soup, no chili oil (兰州清汤牛肉面)
Hand-pulled noodles in beef broth, thin cut (细面)
places.avoid: Say no chili oil; skip cumin lamb, liangpi and other spicy or oily dishes.
places.notes: Opened 2021; still active on Uber Eats (4.7, 2,000+ ratings). Hours 11:30-21:30 come from third-party directories (one says noon opening); call to confirm.

places.name: Lee & Bai Buns and Noodles
places.address: 42-62 Hunter St, Long Island City, NY 11101
buy: Fresh steamed pork or vegetable buns (鲜肉包 / 素包)
Plain noodle soup, ask for no chili (清汤面)
places.avoid: Skip the red-oil dan dan and spicy Chengdu noodles; ask for soy milk hot and unsweetened or lightly sweetened.
places.notes: Opened 2024; second NYC branch of a Chengdu chain (first in Flushing). Hours 08:00-20:00 come only from an Apple Maps listing (which uses 42-64 Hunter St); verify. At the Flushing shop, large single buns are sold only at breakfast. Website leenbai.com.

places.name: Noodlecraft
buy: Hand-pulled beef noodle soup, clear broth (清汤牛肉拉面)
Chicken noodle soup if available (鸡汤面)
Hot water instead of jasmine tea (jasmine tea has caffeine)
places.avoid: No chili oil; skip stir-fried or dry-mixed noodles; jasmine tea contains caffeine.
places.notes: Opened March 2021; noodles hand-pulled in view. Hours from the Toast ordering page (closed Tuesdays); other directories list 20:45 or 19:30 closing, so call ahead.

places.name: Cyclo
buy: Beef pho, no sriracha or lime (phở bò)
places.avoid: No sriracha, chili, lime, mint or basil; skip fried spring rolls and Vietnamese iced coffee.
places.notes: Phone 718-786-8309. Open since 2012, just off Vernon Blvd. Split lunch/dinner hours come from a third-party directory and were not confirmed on the official site (cyclolic.com).

places.name: Chef Papa Vietnamese Kitchen (LIC)
places.address: 42-44 Crescent St, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.avoid: No sriracha, chili or lime; skip fried spring rolls and grilled-pork vermicelli (oily).
places.notes: Phone (929) 600-5568; orders via Toast. Daily 11:00-22:00 comes from a directory listing, not the restaurant. Address sometimes written as Crescent Ct.

places.name: LIC Food Hall (Pho Vital / UniRice / Shimiaodao)
buy: Pho Vital beef or chicken pho, no sriracha (phở)
UniRice onigiri, salmon or plain (おにぎり)
Shimiaodao Yunnan rice noodle soup, mild (云南米线)
places.avoid: Ask for not spicy at the Hunan and Yunnan stalls; skip fried items, iced drinks and bubble tea.
places.notes: Opened August 2025 on the ground floor of Star Tower; 10 vendors over two floors, daily 11:00-22:00 per QNS (Oct 2025). Pho Vital and UniRice are both listed at Suite C3, so stalls may have rotated. Kyuramen (rich tonkotsu broth) is a separate storefront in the same building and is not listed separately.

places.name: Natural Tofu & Noodles
buy: Soft tofu stew, white / not spicy (순두부찌개 하얀)
places.avoid: Insist on the non-spicy white broth; leave the kimchi and chili-paste banchan.
places.notes: Phone 718-706-0899. Time Out lists daily 11:00-23:30, an older source; verify. About 1.3 miles from Court Square, one 7-train stop to 40 St-Lowery St. Closest well-regarded Korean soup kitchen; no seolleongtang specialist found within walking range of Court Square.

places.name: Paris Baguette (LIC Jackson Ave)
places.address: 27-35 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.avoid: Skip chocolate, cream-filled pastries and fried doughnuts; no coffee.
places.notes: Phone (718) 255-6621. Opened January 2022 next to the Queens Plaza subway station. Daily 07:00-22:00 per Queens Post 2022 and directories; the official store page could not be fetched.

places.name: Bricktown Bagels & Cafe
places.address: 51-06 Vernon Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.avoid: Go light on cream cheese; skip coffee and bacon; avoid seeded or everything bagels.
places.notes: Phone (718) 361-2428. Opens 5:30 a.m. weekdays, good for early breakfast. Oatmeal availability unconfirmed; call. Hours from third-party directories.

places.name: MOGMOG
buy: Bento with steamed fish and rice (弁当)
Tofu and miso for soup at home (豆腐 / 味噌)
Udon noodles and Japanese rice (うどん / 米)
Barley tea and decaf teas (麦茶)
places.avoid: Skip cold drinks and large sashimi portions; avoid chocolate and matcha sweets (caffeine).
places.notes: Phone (516) 303-9183. Japanese-owned market opened late 2021. Hours from a recent directory (10:30-20:00, Sunday to 19:00); the opening announcement said 8:00-20:00. The only Japanese grocery within walking range of Court Square.

places.name: H Mart Long Island City
places.address: 48-18 Northern Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.neighborhood: Dutch Kills / Sunnyside border (7 train, 46 St-Bliss St)
buy: Udon, rice-cake soup kits, rice (우동 / 떡국)
places.avoid: Food-court kimchi stew and tteokbokki are spicy; read soup-kit labels to avoid spicy versions.
places.notes: Phone (718) 489-8580. Opened November 2022 in the former Stop & Shop (also listed as 34-51 48th St); food court expanded in 2024 into the chain's largest in NYC. Local press lists daily 09:00-22:00; some directories say 08:00 opening. About 2 miles from Court Square: take the 7 to 46 St-Bliss St, then 12 minutes north on foot.

places.name: Trader Joe's Long Island City
places.address: 22-43 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.avoid: Skip mint chocolate, sparkling drinks and spicy snacks.
places.notes: Opened June 2021 on the ground floor of the Prime Building; no parking. Hours 08:00-21:00 come from the opening announcement; the official store page could not be fetched, so verify.

places.name: CVS Pharmacy (Jackson Ave)
places.address: 25-01 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101
places.notes: Phone (718) 310-5540. Directory hours conflict badly: some say 24 hours, some 07:00-24:00, and InsideRx lists pharmacy-counter hours Mo-Fr 9-19 / Sa 9-17 / Su 10-17. Store hours set here as 07:00-24:00; call first. No confirmed 24-hour pharmacy exists in LIC. Alternatives: Walgreens at 27-26 Queens Plaza S (directories say 09:00-20:00); Duane Reade at 47-02 5th St has unclear status after 2025 Walgreens closures.

places.name: Prestige Marketplace
places.address: 45-45 Center Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11109
buy: Hot chicken soup from the deli
places.avoid: Skip the late-night grill's fried items and bacon; no iced drinks.
places.notes: Opened early 2022 on the ground floor of TF Cornerstone's 45-45 Center Blvd tower; the opening announcement promised 24-hour operation with a 24-hour grill and deli. Directories show it still open, but nobody has confirmed 24-hour service since 2025, so check before a late-night trip. About a 15-minute walk from Court Square.
